# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, only the latest release of Swiftlet on the `master` branch is supported with security updates.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| master  | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Security is a top priority for Swiftlet, especially since we act as a proxy layer for user AI prompts.

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project (e.g., path injection, command injection, memory leaks exposing KV cache, etc.), **please do NOT open a public GitHub issue.**

Instead, please email the project maintainer directly:
**Email:** sourav@Souravs-mac.local *(Note: Update this with your actual email address)*

We will review the report and respond as quickly as possible. Once the issue is resolved, we will publish a fix and credit you in the release notes.

Thank you for helping keep Swiftlet secure!
